description: This file declares APIs for accessing and modifying device information parameters within the COSA Data Model library. It includes function prototypes for getting and setting boolean and string parameters related to device info, specifically under the 'DeviceInfo' object.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for a device info object, given the parameter name.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for a device info object, given the parameter name.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for a device info object, given the parameter name and value.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a device info object, given the parameter name and value.
